definition: Killing a [minion wave](/term/wave) as slowly as possible. Slow pushing is a medium-term wave tactic primarily used when a player has a longer window for manipulating a wave. Slow pushing is a common default tactic because minions naturally tend to move slowly if left undisturbed. Slow pushes happen over 2-4 waves and result in a large buildup of minions before eventually [crashing](/term/crash). The eventual crash gives the player a timer to make a [play](/term/play), such as a [dive](/term/dive), [roam](/term/roam), or recall.
